arxiv-2010-11791.title: ConVEx : Data-Efficient and Few-Shot Slot Labeling
arxiv-2010-11791.creator: Matthew Henderson, Ivan Vulić
arxiv-2010-11791.description: Abstract We propose ConVEx ( Con versational V alue Ex tractor), an efficient pretraining and fine-tuning neural approach for slot-labeling dialog tasks. Instead of relying on more general pretraining objectives from prior work (e.g., language modeling, response selection), ConVEx’s pretraining objective, a novel pairwise cloze task using Reddit data, is well aligned with its intended usage on sequence labeling tasks.

arxiv-2503-11040.title: Evaluation of the Impact of IBR on the Frequency Dynamics in the Brazilian Power System
arxiv-2503-11040.creator: Bruno Pinheiro, M. C. Llerena Velasquez, Giovane Faria, A. F. C. Aquino, Diego Issicaba, Daniel Dotta
arxiv-2503-11040.description: Abstract In this paper, the impact of inverter-based resources (IBRs) on the frequency dynamics of the Brazilian Interconnected Power System (BIPS) is evaluated. A measurement-based framework is proposed to assess the impact of IBR penetration on the system-wide and regional/local frequency dynamic.

arxiv-2509-12667.title: Osu2MIR: Beat Tracking Dataset Derived From Osu! Data
arxiv-2509-12667.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the use of Osu!, a community-based rhythm game, as an alternative source of beat and downbeat annotations. Osu! beatmaps are created and refined by a large, diverse community and span underrepresented genres such as anime, Vocaloid, and video game music. We introduce a pipeline for extracting annotations from Osu!

pmc-11517338.title: Paediatric iGAS Morbidity and Mortality in Ireland 2022-2023 episodic upsurge
pmc-11517338.creator: O Cotter, D Foley, F Cloak, U Fallon, CÓ Maoldomhnaigh, P Mc Keown
pmc-11517338.description: There was an unseasonal upsurge in invasive Group A Streptococcal (iGAS) activity in Ireland during the 2022/2023 winter period. In particular, there was an increase in the proportion of paediatric infections and a rise in the age specific death rate for those under the age of 18, from 0.10 to 1.43 per 100,000.

pmc-11679788.title: Plasma microRNAs as Biomarkers for Predicting Radiotherapy Treatment-Induced Cardiotoxicity in Lung Cancer
pmc-11679788.creator: Paulina Kazlauskaitė, Ieva Vaicekauskaitė, Jonas Venius, Rasa Sabaliauskaitė, Rita Steponavičienė
pmc-11679788.description: Background: Lung cancer is the second most common malignancy and stands as a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Currently, one of the main treatment options for lung cancer is radiotherapy, but this treatment is associated with complications, such as an increased risk of cardiac-related morbidity and mortality. However, currently available methods for predicting radiation-induced heart disease (RIHD) remain suboptimal.

pmc-11883084.title: Accurate fully automated assessment of left ventricle, left atrium, and left atrial appendage function from computed tomography using deep learning
pmc-11883084.creator: Lee Jollans, Mariana Bustamante, Lilian Henriksson, Anders Persson, Tino Ebbers
pmc-11883084.description: AimsAssessment of cardiac function is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning in cardiovascular disease. Volume of cardiac regions and the derived measures of stroke volume (SV) and ejection fraction (EF) are most accurately calculated from imaging. This study aims to develop a fully automatic deep learning approach for calculation of cardiac function from computed tomography (CT).

pmc-12579636.title: Surface-Engineered Mitochondria with Targeting Potential for Endothelial Repair
pmc-12579636.creator: Brandon Applewhite, Natalia Matiuto, Aurea del Carmen, Bin Jiang
pmc-12579636.description: PurposeMitochondrial dysfunction contributes to endothelial injury in vascular diseases and interventions. While mitochondrial transplantation offers a promising therapeutic strategy, current approaches lack target specificity, efficient uptake, and long-term retention. This study presents a surface-engineering approach to enhance mitochondria delivery to the vascular endothelium as a step toward novel endothelial repair strategies.

pmc-12594804.title: ANN-based fault classification and localization with optimized PMU deployment for transmission systems
pmc-12594804.creator: T Malini, P Thirumoorthi, K Lakshmi
pmc-12594804.description: Accurate and timely Fault Detection (FD) remains a fundamental challenge in transmission systems due to the dynamic operating conditions of modern power grids, the diversity of fault types, and fast reclosure events. Conventional fault diagnosis techniques are often constrained by assumptions of static load profiles, dependence on high-rate sampling, or extensive data requirements, which hinder their real-time deployment.

pmc-13659371.creator: Antonio Flores‐Moya, Ignacio J. Melero‐Jiménez, María J. García‐Sánchez, Elena Bañares‐España
pmc-13659371.description: The availability of easy‐to‐measure and inexpensive biomarkers is a challenge for monitoring environmental stress in organisms. Although it has been proposed that non‐directional deviations from a symmetrical pattern in morphological traits (called fluctuating asymmetry. FA) may be directly related to environmental stress, this postulate has been questioned.
